# OBS011 `labelled-do-loop`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A labelled `do 10 i = ...` loop.

## Why

The label form of DO is obsolescent since Fortran 2018. `do ... end do` (optionally with a
construct name) states the loop's extent without a label to match.

## Reported

```fortran
do 10 i = 1, n
  a(i) = 0.0
10 continue
```

## Preferred

```fortran
do i = 1, n
  a(i) = 0.0
end do
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OBS011] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OBS011` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `OB091` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
